newsitem.title: USA: Cognizant unit unveils market analysis tool.
newsitem.headline: Cognizant unit unveils market analysis tool.

text.p: IMS America, a unit of Cognizant Corp, on Friday said it developed a market-analysis service to provide patient-level data on the cholesterol prescription market.
IMS said the information is drawn from its new LifeLink Primary Care database, which covers more than 600,000 patients included in office-based electronic medical records.

LifeLink is designed to answer such questions as to what extent physicians comply with National Institutes of Health guidelines on cholesterol treatment, or how often patients are switched to other drug therapies and the average time interval involved.
IMS said it is planning similar patient-level analyses for seven other diseases.
